description: Stop a stream that is live or starting. It stops publishing and becomes inactive; nothing is deleted and it can be started again with the same configuration. Does NOT cancel a recurring schedule — a daily or weekly stream stopped here starts again at its next window, so call cancel_stream_schedule as well to keep it off.
